name: NexusCommander
description: A cross-platform, high-performance orthodox (dual-pane) file manager built with Tauri and SvelteKit.

core_ui: TwinPanels: Orthodox dual-pane interface with vertical/horizontal split toggles
Tabbed Navigation: Multiple folder tabs per panel
MenuBar & Toolbar: Home, Up, Refresh, View Mode toggles, and Search
CommandLine: Direct execution of shell commands and internal VFS commands (e.g., cd)
FunctionKeyBar: TC-style F3 (View) to F10 (Exit) quick actions
TaskProgress: Visual tracking of background file operations
Breadcrumbs: Interactive path navigation for each panel
virtual_file_system: High-performance directory reading with symlink detection
file_operations: CRUD: Robust creation, deletion (recursive), renaming, and moves
Multi-Rename Tool: Batch renaming with pattern support
Drag & Drop: Future target (currently mediated via F-keys/toolbar)
Selection Management: TC-style selection (Insert, Space, Gray +, Gray -)
archive_handling: Transparent VFS: Browse ZIP/TAR/GZ archives like standard folders
Pack/Unpack: native archive creation and extraction support (Alt+F5, Alt+F9)
task_queue_manager: Asynchronous background operations for long-running Copy/Move/Delete tasks
Concurrency: Manage and monitor multiple tasks via stateful queue
Error Handling: Robust reporting and task cancellation
built_in_viewer: Multimodal Viewer: Text, Hex, and Image viewing support
Embedded Mode: QuickView toggle to view files in the opposite panel
additional_features: Hotlist/Bookmarks: Categorized favorites with persistent storage (Ctrl+D)
Advanced Search: File discovery with regex and content-query support
Terminal Integration: Instant terminal access in current directory (F9)
Network Support: Mapping and disconnecting network drives
Theme Engine: Comprehensive customization of colors, backgrounds, and typography

status: Phase 5 Complete - Core functionality fully implemented and verified on native backend.
